narrative:
## Handover Summary — HR Application (Workforce)

Headcount roll-forward validated from SuccessFactors: hires, leavers, transfers and open positions by cost centre and month. Personal data masked; planning at position level for FP&A, FTE level for everyone else.

## Key Decisions
• 15 open positions held through Q1 2027 (−€1.5M a year)
• Private Banking hiring protected (growth in capital-light business)
• Salary increase 2027 planned at the collective-agreement rate

## Recommendation for Operating Costs
Cost per FTE growth below 3% in 2027 is needed for the CIR path below 60%.

signals.title: Path to CIR < 60%: +€11.3M income, −€6.5M cost
signals.excerpt: AUM +5%, Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, MOPS price list +3%, Oracle decommission, purchased services, 15 open positions → CIR 58.7%, ROE 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses).
